tests: a real git merge --ff-only moves the ref and the block permits every path it wrote

consumesExternalOutput.program: git, run for real: a repository is created, a merge --ff-only is executed, and the paths it wrote are derived from the filesystem
consumesExternalOutput.provenance: The ref-update paths are not a list of strings that look like refs: the test snapshots the clone, runs the merge, and takes the difference, so the carve-out is asserted against what git actually wrote. The cited captures are the harness payload shapes the same test feeds to the wrapper.
